exact_source: Fuls, 'A Digital Corpus and Epigraphical Database for Indus Script Research', Book of Abstracts, Emerging Perspectives of the Harappan Civilization, IIT Gandhinagar, 10-12 Feb 2023
what_it_says: Because excavated artefact numbers differ by site, a modified chi-square test compares sign frequencies with the frequencies expected under a homogeneous distribution. what_it_says: Says the context of sign modifications and of signs relative to other entities on the object must be understood and set within the wider culture, that composite signs and add-on elements need to be isolated and studied, and that understanding the Harappans better must precede questions about what they wrote.

exact_source: Green, 'Finding Harappan Seal Carvers: An Operational Sequence Approach to Identifying People in the Past', Journal of Archaeological Science 72 (2016) 128-141
what_it_says: On five unicorn seals from Mohenjo-daro, microtopographic differences in operational sequence indicate three carvers; the author calls the results preliminary insights into communities of practice and says the approach can extend inquiry into the social conditions of seal production.
